workflows.name: Authentication & Role Switching
workflows.expected: Seamless role switching between admin, analyst, and viewer with JWT token update
workflows.actual: Switched roles cleanly: initial=adminadmin, analyst=security_analyst, viewer=viewer

workflows.name: Dashboard Intelligence & Attention Queue
workflows.expected: Analyst Priority Attention Queue, Asset Risk Overview, and Recent Incidents displayed

workflows.name: Assets Inventory & Critical Asset Filter
workflows.expected: Monitored digital assets displayed with criticality badges and metadata
workflows.actual: Found 5 registered enterprise digital assets in assets table

workflows.name: Synthetic Security Event Ingestion
workflows.expected: Synthetic security scenario generated and ingested with SHA-256 fingerprinting
workflows.actual: Ingestion Summary (SYNTHETIC_GENERATOR): Received 1 • Imported 1 • Duplicates Skipped 0 • Failed 0 • Detections 1

workflows.name: Deterministic Detection Engine & Explainable Risk
workflows.expected: Rules evaluated, supporting telemetry evidence extracted, and 5-factor risk score computed

workflows.name: Multi-Factor Event Correlation
workflows.expected: Events grouped into correlated threat clusters based on time window, source IP, and target asset

workflows.name: Incident Lifecycle (open -> investigating -> contained -> closed)
workflows.expected: Incident assigned, notes added, status transitioned to investigating, contained, resolved with root cause, and closed in PostgreSQL
workflows.actual: Timeline successfully updated with resolution & state transitions: hasResolved=true

workflows.name: Advisory Response Playbooks
workflows.expected: 5 NIST SP 800-61 aligned advisory response playbooks available (PB-IR-001 to PB-IR-005)
workflows.actual: Found 5 active response playbooks with copyable containment commands

workflows.name: Append-Only Audit Trail
workflows.expected: All security-critical actions recorded with actor, action type, and client IP in append-only table
workflows.actual: Audit log entries captured: hasAnalyst=true, hasOperationalActions=true

workflows.name: RBAC Viewer Write Restriction
workflows.expected: Viewer role blocked from creating assets or modifying incidents
